- Dates: Check‑in Dec 24, 2026; check‑out Dec 27, 2026.

  • Non‑smoking (if that matters)

  • Minimum stay requirement (you’re at 3 nights—make sure 3 is allowed).  
  • Holiday/peak pricing or mandatory fees (e.g., resort fee, parking, “holiday surcharge”).

4) Check total price and policies before you click “Book”  
On the booking page, look specifically for:  
- Total for stay (not just per night): base rate + taxes + fees.  
- Cancellation policy:  
  • Free cancellation until what date/time?  
  • Is it non‑refundable or fully prepaid?  
- Deposit requirements:

- Check‑in/check‑out times.  
- Parking fees and whether breakfast is included.

- Dates, room type, names, total price, and policies.
